meaningMnemonic: The bright (明) sky (天) that has not arrived yet: tomorrow.
readingMnemonic: Both characters keep their own readings: míng tiān.

meaningMnemonic: The white (白) part of the day (天) — the hours while the sun is up.
readingMnemonic: bái tiān: second tone rising, then a flat first tone.

meaningMnemonic: Day (天) after day (天). Doubling a word like this is how Chinese says 'every', and it is half the name of this app.
readingMnemonic: Just say tiān twice, both flat.

meaningMnemonic: Big (大) and small (小) glued together stop being opposites and become the scale itself: size.
readingMnemonic: dà xiǎo: fourth tone dropping, then third tone dipping.

meaningMnemonic: Bright (明) and white (白): once a thing is lit up with no shadow left on it, you understand it.
readingMnemonic: The second syllable goes neutral: míng bai, not míng bái.

meaningMnemonic: The early (早) part sitting up (上) at the top of the day.
readingMnemonic: zǎo shang: 上 drops to a neutral tone in this word.

meaningMnemonic: Not (不) good (好). The plainest complaint in the language.
readingMnemonic: bù hǎo: 不 stays fourth tone because 好 is third.

meaningMnemonic: Too (太) big (大) — said of a shirt, a bill, or an idea.
readingMnemonic: tài dà: two fourth tones falling one after the other.

meaningMnemonic: Too (太) doubled turns into a title: Mrs., or somebody's wife.
readingMnemonic: tài tai: the second syllable goes neutral.

meaningMnemonic: You (你) good (好): the first thing anybody learns to say in Chinese.
readingMnemonic: Two third tones in a row, so the first one shifts up. It actually comes out as ní hǎo.

meaningMnemonic: You (你) with the plural marker (们): more than one of you.
readingMnemonic: nǐ men: 们 is always unstressed.

meaningMnemonic: He (他) plus the plural marker (们): they, or any mixed group.
readingMnemonic: tā men: flat first tone, then neutral.

meaningMnemonic: She (她) plus the plural marker (们): a group of women.
readingMnemonic: Sounds exactly like 他们. Only the writing tells them apart.

meaningMnemonic: What (什) with its question suffix (么). The question word you will reach for most often.
readingMnemonic: shén me: the 么 is swallowed, close to 'shummuh'.

meaningMnemonic: Mother (妈) said twice, the way a small child says it.
readingMnemonic: mā ma: first tone, then neutral.

meaningMnemonic: Good (好) plus the question particle (吗): you have turned 'good' into 'good?'.
readingMnemonic: hǎo ma: the particle carries no tone.

meaningMnemonic: The centre (中) of the gap (间): the space right in between.
readingMnemonic: zhōng jiān: two flat first tones.

meaningMnemonic: To ask (问) whether someone is good (好): to say hello, or pass on your regards.
readingMnemonic: wèn hǎo: falling, then dipping.

meaningMnemonic: The name (名) written out in characters (字): a person's name.
readingMnemonic: 字 goes neutral here: míng zi.

meaningMnemonic: Time (时) measured in the gap (间) between two moments: time as something you can spend.
readingMnemonic: shí jiān: rising, then flat.

meaningMnemonic: A small (小) piece of time (时): one hour.
readingMnemonic: xiǎo shí: third tone then second.

meaningMnemonic: The big (大) household (家): everybody in the room.
readingMnemonic: dà jiā: falling, then flat.

meaningMnemonic: How many (多) big (大): the normal way to ask someone's age or the size of a thing.
readingMnemonic: duō dà: first tone then fourth.

meaningMnemonic: Good (好) to look at (看): pretty, or a good read.
readingMnemonic: hǎo kàn: third then fourth.

meaningMnemonic: Look (看) doubled softens it into 'just have a quick look'.
readingMnemonic: kàn kan: the second one goes neutral, and that is what makes it casual.

meaningMnemonic: Think (想) doubled: give it a moment's thought.
readingMnemonic: xiǎng xiang: again the second syllable drops to neutral.

meaningMnemonic: Two different words for friend (朋 and 友) glued together into the everyday one.
readingMnemonic: péng you: 友 loses its third tone and goes neutral.

meaningMnemonic: Go out (出) and away (去): out of here, away from the speaker.
readingMnemonic: chū qù: flat then falling.

meaningMnemonic: To be at (在) home (家): where you are, rather than where you are going.
readingMnemonic: zài jiā: falling then flat.

meaningMnemonic: Not (不) correct (对): wrong.
readingMnemonic: 不 sits in front of a fourth tone, so it lifts to second: bú duì.

meaningMnemonic: A good (好) friend (朋友): three characters you already know, in a row.
readingMnemonic: hǎo péng you, with the last syllable neutral.

meaningMnemonic: Not (不) many (多): not much of it left.
readingMnemonic: bù duō: 多 is first tone, so 不 keeps its full fourth tone.

meaningMnemonic: The Han (汉) language (语): Chinese as a spoken language.
readingMnemonic: hàn yǔ: falling, then dipping.

meaningMnemonic: Han (汉) characters (字) — the writing this whole app is named after.
readingMnemonic: hàn zì: two fourth tones, both falling.

meaningMnemonic: To speak (说) speech (话): the act of talking.
readingMnemonic: shuō huà: flat then falling.

meaningMnemonic: Electric (电) speech (话): talk sent down a wire.
readingMnemonic: diàn huà: two fourth tones.

meaningMnemonic: Thanks (谢) said twice, which is how it is actually said.
readingMnemonic: xiè xie: the second one goes neutral.

meaningMnemonic: Watery (水) fruit (果): the juicy kind you eat raw, as opposed to nuts.
readingMnemonic: Two third tones, so the first rises: it comes out as shuí guǒ.

meaningMnemonic: Return (回) and come (来): back here, towards the speaker.
readingMnemonic: huí lái: two rising second tones.

meaningMnemonic: Return (回) and go (去): back there, away from the speaker.
readingMnemonic: huí qù: rising then falling.

meaningMnemonic: Return (回) home (家): the trip back, not the house itself.
readingMnemonic: huí jiā: rising then flat.

meaningMnemonic: Go out (出) and come (来): out towards the speaker.
readingMnemonic: chū lái: flat then rising.

meaningMnemonic: Look (看) and actually see (见): the looking succeeded.
readingMnemonic: kàn jiàn: two fourth tones.

meaningMnemonic: Good (好) to eat (吃): delicious.
readingMnemonic: hǎo chī: third then first.

meaningMnemonic: Speak (说) until it is bright (明): to make a thing clear.
readingMnemonic: shuō míng: flat then rising.

meaningMnemonic: Go up (上) to study (学): the daily trip to school.
readingMnemonic: shàng xué: falling then rising.

meaningMnemonic: The big (大) school (学): the one you go to last.
readingMnemonic: dà xué: falling then rising.

meaningMnemonic: The middle (中) school (学): the one between primary and university.
readingMnemonic: zhōng xué: flat then rising.

meaningMnemonic: The small (小) school (学): where the small ones go.
readingMnemonic: xiǎo xué: dipping then rising.

meaningMnemonic: Study (学) a thing until it is good (好): learn it properly.
readingMnemonic: xué hǎo: rising then dipping.

meaningMnemonic: I (我) with the plural marker (们): us.
readingMnemonic: wǒ men: 们 unstressed, as always.

meaningMnemonic: Not (不) to be (是): the flat denial.
readingMnemonic: In front of a fourth tone 不 lifts to second: bú shì.

meaningMnemonic: One who studies (学) and is still growing (生): a student.
readingMnemonic: xué sheng: 生 usually goes neutral in this word.

meaningMnemonic: The venerable (老) master (师). The 老 is respect, not age.
readingMnemonic: lǎo shī: dipping then flat.

meaningMnemonic: The middle (中) country (国): the Middle Kingdom.
readingMnemonic: zhōng guó: flat then rising.

meaningMnemonic: Middle-kingdom (中) writing (文): Chinese, especially the written language.
readingMnemonic: zhōng wén: flat then rising.

meaningMnemonic: The nation (国) treated as one household (家): a country.
readingMnemonic: guó jiā: rising then flat.

meaningMnemonic: The fire (火) vehicle (车): the one that ran on burning coal.
readingMnemonic: huǒ chē: dipping then flat.

meaningMnemonic: Get up (上) into the vehicle (车) — the same 上 that means 'up' does duty for boarding anything.
readingMnemonic: shàng chē: falling then flat.

meaningMnemonic: Get down (下) out of the vehicle (车), the mirror image of 上车.
readingMnemonic: xià chē: falling then flat.

meaningMnemonic: Go out (出) of the country (国).
readingMnemonic: chū guó: flat then rising.

meaningMnemonic: Return (回) to your own country (国).
readingMnemonic: huí guó: two rising tones.

meaningMnemonic: To have (有) a name (名): people know who you are.
readingMnemonic: yǒu míng: dipping then rising.

meaningMnemonic: On top (上) of the ground (地).
readingMnemonic: dì shang: 上 goes neutral in position words like this.

meaningMnemonic: Sit (坐) down (下). Both halves are literal, and together they are what a Chinese host says first.
readingMnemonic: zuò xià: two fourth tones.

meaningMnemonic: Sit (坐) in a vehicle (车): to go somewhere by bus, car or train.
readingMnemonic: zuò chē: falling then flat.

meaningMnemonic: Your old (老) home (家): the place your family comes from.
readingMnemonic: lǎo jiā: dipping then flat.

meaningMnemonic: Writing (文) and characters (字): a writing system.
readingMnemonic: wén zì: rising then falling.

meaningMnemonic: Spoken language (语) and writing (文): the school subject that covers both.
readingMnemonic: yǔ wén: dipping then rising.

meaningMnemonic: Is (是), not (不), is (是): the standard way to build a yes-no question in Chinese.
readingMnemonic: The middle 不 is swallowed: shì bu shì.

meaningMnemonic: A university (大学) student (生).
readingMnemonic: dà xué shēng: falling, rising, flat.

meaningMnemonic: A middle-school (中学) student (生).
readingMnemonic: zhōng xué shēng: flat, rising, flat.

meaningMnemonic: An old (老) friend (朋友) — old in years of friendship, not in age.
readingMnemonic: lǎo péng you, with the last syllable neutral.

meaningMnemonic: My (我) home (家). Possession needs no extra word here.
readingMnemonic: wǒ jiā: dipping then flat.

meaningMnemonic: There are (有) times (时) when: sometimes.
readingMnemonic: yǒu shí: dipping then rising.

meaningMnemonic: A raw (生) character (字): one you have not cooked yet. 生 also means uncooked.
readingMnemonic: shēng zì: flat then falling.

meaningMnemonic: Studying (学) and asking (问): everything you know from having done both.
readingMnemonic: xué wen: the second syllable goes neutral.

meaningMnemonic: To come out (出) and start living (生).
readingMnemonic: chū shēng: two flat first tones.

meaningMnemonic: The old (老) big (大) one: the eldest child, or whoever is in charge.
readingMnemonic: lǎo dà: dipping then falling.

meaningMnemonic: Tomorrow (明天) we see (见) each other.
readingMnemonic: míng tiān jiàn: rising, flat, falling.
